about: Which properties each Custom UI element type has. Written by UiTypeTable.generate; do not edit by hand. Run the tests once with AETHERHAVEN_WRITE_UI_TABLE set after a game update.

sources.docs: The official Custom UI type documentation (Hypixel Studios), as read through its mirror at hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/official-documentation/custom-ui/type-documentation on 2026-10-10 for game 0.6.8 and recorded, table by table, in the hytale-modding skill (references/research/custom-ui-format.md, sections 2.1 to 2.4). A property marked documented false is one that file measured in the release game's documents but the documentation leaves out. Converted by a script, not retyped. This is the only part of the property table that is not read from the installed game.
sources.files: 409 documents shipped with the game: 169 in Assets.zip Common/UI/Custom, 199 in Client/Data/Game/Interface, 41 in Client/Data/Editor/Interface. A number is how many elements of that type have the property written on them, templates resolved. The client refuses a document that writes an unknown property, so each is proof.
sources.server: 52 classes of Server/HytaleServer.jar that name a game document: each text constant shaped like #Id.Property, counted for the element type #Id has in the documents that class names, when that is one type only.
sources.client: Client/HytaleClient.exe: true when the program's member names include exactly this name. It says the name exists, not on which type.
